input:
CURRENT SCENE:
他觉得，这种一定是做药的花。原来他想错了。吃了以后，神农快生病。 这时一个穿着蓝色衣服的人帮神农，快给他一种红的灵芝。神农吃了以后，他没有病，想起来以前一个人告诉他，灵芝对身体有好处。

ITEMS:

[I310] 这种【^】一定是做药的花   correction: ∅ → 花   strength: suggestion
  rule card (collocation_selection, Vocabulary): Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <word/expression> does not normally collocate with <noun/action/situation>; use <correct> instead.  Her terms: Time + 期间, V.得很厉害, 着durative, no了for habit/routine
  her past correction: 和这个花[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction: 他正好吃[一毒→一种有毒]的花
  her past correction: 有的花[是毒→有毒]

[I311] 神农【^】快生病   correction: ∅ → 很   strength: error
  checker's note: 很快 means “soon”; 快 alone is not natural here
  rule card (perception_look_see, Vocabulary): 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person actually sees/catches sight of <thing or situation>, so use 看到, not 看.  Her terms: 看look vs.看到see, no了, 看look, 看到see
  her past correction: 神农[看了→看到了]很多生病的人 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction: ⟦神农⟧看到很多人生病了 — her note: better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
  her past correction: 所以神农吃[+了]以后就生病了 — her note: 了completed

[I312] 神农快生病【^】   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: error
  checker's note: the illness began after the completed action
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 所以神农吃[+了]以后就生病了 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 神农[看了→看到了]很多生病的人 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction: 神农没死[-了] — her note: 没+ V.

[I313] 【快】给他一种红的灵芝   correction: 快 → 赶快   strength: error
  checker's note: 赶快 is the adverb “quickly/hurriedly” here
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 给[+了]他一个灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: [给→给了]他一个灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 那个人给[+了]他灵芝 — her note: 了completed

[I314] 快给【^】他一种红的灵芝   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: error
  checker's note: giving the lingzhi is a completed past action
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 给[+了]他一个灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: [给→给了]他一个灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 那个人给[+了]他灵芝 — her note: 了completed

[I315] 快给他【一种】红的灵芝   correction: 一种 → 一朵   strength: suggestion
  checker's note: 一种 means a type; a single lingzhi needs an individual classifier
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 给[+了]他一个灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: [给→给了]他一个灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 那个人给[+了]他灵芝 — her note: 了completed

[I316] 他【没有病】   correction: 没有病 → 的病好了   strength: error
  checker's note: 病好了 means that his illness recovered
  rule card (no_le_with_mei, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): After 没/没有 with an action verb for an action that did not happen, use 没 + V. and do not add 了.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this action did not happen, so use 没 + V. with no 了 (no了in “没+V.”).  Her terms: 没+ V., no了in “没+V.”, verb is an action verb
  her past correction: 和他[没病了→病好了] — her note: 没 +V., no了, the verb is an action verb
  her past correction: [然后，不病→就好了] — her note: “病” is not a normal Adj., so it cannot be with 很 or 不
  her past correction: [-和]他没病了 — her note: 和cannot link clauses

items.explanation: It would be more natural to say 这种花: 这种 needs a noun here, and 花 names the flower.
快 alone is not natural before 生病 here. Use 很快 to mean “soon.”
Becoming ill is a completed change in the story, so use 了completed: 生病了.
Use 赶快 here to mean “quickly” or “hurriedly.” 快 alone is not natural in this position.
Giving the lingzhi is completed in the story, so it takes 了completed: 给了.
It would be more natural to say 一朵灵芝 for one individual lingzhi. 一种 means one type of lingzhi.
没有病 means that he does not have an illness. Here his illness recovered, so say 他的病好了.
